<fidel-player>

Lesson player. The accessible lesson video player: captions in three languages, sign language, transcript, audio description and offline lessons.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Deaf and hard-of-hearing learners (captions, sign language), blind and low-vision learners (screen-reader controls, audio description, transcript), keyboard users, and learners on cheap phones (low-data video, offline lessons).

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/y0hannesHK/fidel-alx-hackathon@v1.0.0-cdn/fidel.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/y0hannesHK/fidel-alx-hackathon@v1.0.0-cdn/fidel.js" defer></script>

<fidel-player src="lesson.mp4" captions-en="en.vtt" captions-am="am.vtt"
              captions-am-status="draft" chapters="chapters.vtt" sign="sign.webm"
              lang="en"></fidel-player>

Source: player/src/fidel-player.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-player>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
lessonURLnoneA lesson on a Fidel server (/api/v1/lessons/ID). Fills in all the other attributes.
srcURLnoneThe video (MP4).
src-webmURLnoneThe same video as WebM (optional).
src-smallURLnoneA small video for "Use less data".
posterURLnoneImage shown before playing.
captions-en, captions-am, captions-omURL (WebVTT)noneCaptions in English, Amharic and Afaan Oromo.
captions-am-status, captions-om-statusdraft, reviewednonedraft shows the notice that the captions are machine-made and not yet checked.
chapters-en (or chapters), chapters-amURL (WebVTT)noneChapter titles.
descriptions-en (or descriptions), descriptions-am, descriptions-omURL (WebVTT)noneAudio description text, read by the browser or screen reader.
description-recordingsJSONnoneRecorded descriptions, e.g. {"am":[{"start":12.5,"url":"d1.opus"}]}.
signURLnoneSign-language video (WebM or MP4), shown beside or over the video.
offline-page, offline-page-video, offline-packURLnoneOffline downloads: one-page lesson (audio and text), the same with video, and a .zip pack.
offline-page-size, offline-page-video-size, offline-pack-sizebytesnoneSizes shown on the download buttons (filled in from the lesson).
document-html-en, document-html-am, document-pdf-en, document-pdf-am, document-brf-en, document-brf-amURLnoneThe lesson document as a web page, tagged PDF and Braille (filled in from the lesson).
langen, amenDefault language of the player's interface. A learner's own choice in the player is remembered and wins.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-player>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-ready{ lang, captionLanguages, hasSignLanguage }The player is built.
fidel-progress{ seconds, percent }At most every 5 seconds of playback.
fidel-ended{ duration }The lesson was watched to the end.
fidel-complete{}Same moment as fidel-ended.
fidel-captions-change{ lang } (en, am, om or off)The learner chose a caption language.
fidel-language-change{ lang }The interface language changed.
fidel-low-data-change{ lowData }"Use less data" was switched on or off.
fidel-offline-saved{ url }The lesson was saved for offline use.
fidel-prefs{ captionSize, captionColor, captionLanguage, signPosition, signSize, lowData, language }The learner changed a display choice.
fidel-error{ message }Something could not be loaded.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • Every control is a real <button> with a name (Play, Back 10 seconds, Captions, Sign language, Transcript, Full screen).
  • While the player has focus: K or Space plays and pauses; the Left and Right arrow keys move 5 seconds. The Keyboard help button lists the keys.
  • Transcript lines are buttons ("Play from 1:33"); "Follow along" scrolling switches off when a keyboard user enters the transcript.
  • Times are read as words ("1 minute 33 seconds"), not as numbers.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Interface in English or Amharic (lang). Captions, chapters and audio descriptions in English, Amharic and Afaan Oromo.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded): Captions in three languages; machine-made captions are marked as not yet checked.
  • 1.2.5 Audio Description (Prerecorded): Audio description read by the browser or screen reader, or recordings made by staff.
  • 1.2.6 Sign Language (AAA): Sign-language window beside the video, in three sizes; no dragging needed.
  • 2.1.1 Keyboard: Every control works with the keyboard.
  • 1.4.10 Reflow: No sideways scrolling at 320 px; the sign window moves under the video.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
